facts.claim: "Might Be Right" is a White Reaper single and the lead single from their third studio album, You Deserve Love.
You Deserve Love was recorded with producer Jay Joyce in Nashville, Tennessee, and is White Reaper's Elektra Records debut.
Jay Joyce's production credits include Halestorm, Cage the Elephant, The Head and the Heart and Eric Church.
The album lineup is Tony Esposito (vocals/guitar), Hunter Thompson (guitar), Ryan Hater (keyboards), Sam Wilkerson (bass) and Nick Wilkerson (drums).
Tony Esposito said recording was easy because the band already knew the songs and played most of them live, so it felt like a practice.
The "Might Be Right" music video was released May 27, 2019, and was directed by Daniel Ryan and produced by Jonah Mueller.

"Might Be Right" was White Reaper's first song to reach a Billboard chart. It peaked at Nos. 12, 16 and 17 on the Adult Alternative Songs, Alternative Songs and Rock Airplay charts dated Oct. 19, 2019.
The song later reached Number 1 on Billboard's Alternative Airplay chart.
White Reaper played "Might Be Right" and "Real Long Time" on Jimmy Kimmel Live! in December 2019.

White Reaper formed in 2012 in Louisville, Kentucky, and signed to Polyvinyl in 2014. They released White Reaper Does It Again in 2015 and The World's Best American Band in 2017, before moving to Elektra for You Deserve Love.
